lastTask: Implement Byte 15c-a deterministic band consensus for chorus candidates

projectState.summary: Byte 15c-a is ready for Claude review on codex/byte-15c-a. A model/deterministic chorus proposal now goes through deterministic band consensus before becoming the active audible candidate. Pulse, bass, and melody produce accept/defer/push responses over the app-owned candidate menu; the inspector exposes Consensus/Responses; and persistence records proposed id/source separately from the consensus-selected candidate. Validation is green: npm audit, npm run build, npm run db:smoke, git diff --check, and npm run smoke (28/28).
